top_choice_rationale: Targeted protein degradation turned regulated protein turnover into a defined chemical event, small-molecule-induced ternary complex formation followed by ligase-dependent ubiquitination. The principle has been reproduced independently across ligases, targets and chemotypes, and cooperativity is measurable. Crews and Deshaies conceived the PROTAC concept and Handa's cereblon identification explains thalidomide-class glues, so three names under one citation respects the cap. Costs I accept: no approved PROTAC drug that I could verify, Handa's work being target identification, and Ciulli left out. Nitrogenase is next because its structure has been independently confirmed for decades, followed by C-N coupling, which is mature but overlaps the 2010 prize. Phase separation is still unsettled in cells, and no award ranks last.
